entries.read: The HIGHEST-VARIANCE name on this board and the one most likely to produce an unexamined-hit, so it gets an explicit probability rather than a shrug: p(|move| > 15% on the print) ~= 22%, far above the board's mega-cap baseline, because HBM pricing/allocation commentary is the live argument in the whole AI trade and the stock just repriced -5.2% into it. I STILL PASS, and the reason is not timidity: I have no variant view on HBM supply that the entire sell-side does not already have, and a 22% chance of a big move is symmetric - it is a coin flip with a wide coin, not an edge. Buying it would be substituting volatility for edge. The honest version of this trade is the second-order supply chain, which I have not done the work on and will not pretend to. PASS, and if it gaps +20% I will log it as a category cost.
